description: List workspaces the current user has access to. Typically the first call of a session. If exactly one workspace matches, its module list is returned too (`autoSelected`) — no set_workspace or list_modules needed. The MCP keeps no workspace between calls: pass the chosen workspace's id as workspaceId on every later call. Administrators: without `search` this lists your own memberships; pass `search` to find any workspace by name.

workspaceId.description: Not used by this tool: accepted, and ignored, so a call that carries it is not refused.

name: list_workspaces
title: List Workspaces
